description: Save a live formula to the account so it can be streamed (blackforge_formula_watch) and carry notifications (blackforge_alert_create). Returns { formula: { id, name, expr, interval, pairs, horizonSeconds, ... } }. A refused formula comes back as an error with the same located, coded detail blackforge_formula_validate gives; validate first. Saving is free; a formula is charged one row per referenced pair per evaluation only while it is streamed or watched by a notification. Live formulas and notifications are part of the Ultra plan.

ephemeral.description: true stores it for one hour only, outside the saved-formula count. Default false.

expr.description: The formula source (see blackforge_formula_validate for the language).

name: blackforge_formula_create
title: Save a live formula
